proposals.status: Structurally feasible as a replacement; exact ZIP, ABI, callback, reset and runtime validation remain to be run by root/packager.
Structurally feasible as a two-entry replacement; exact ZIP, ABI, callback, reset and runtime validation remain to be run by root/packager.

new_fixed_endpoint_feasibility.runtime_and_precision_limits: The source TL3 ZIP carries wnn_cpp CPython 3.11 ISA binaries and dynamically quantizes non-fp32 members. Existing H390 ZIPs use a separate wnn_native ABI and precision path. Structural NPZ compatibility does not establish cross-wrapper prediction parity, quantization error or callback cost. No runtime or scientific score was measured for these two proposals.
new_fixed_endpoint_feasibility.saved_component_predictions: Member-bank E S3/S4 diagnostics contain FP32 predictions for 1,873 validation row groups each, but these are all-data-trained members and not clean held-out evidence or an exact native TL3 package score. Existing original TL3 cache is a separate exposed diagnostic; no exact composite package prediction/score was found.
new_fixed_endpoint_feasibility.historical_public_exclusions: Previously reported public results include H390 S3/S4 equal at 0.6656, H390 S3/Z4 at 0.6668, and H390 S3/S4/Z4 at 0.6671 (submissions/10-12-best-r1/PUBLIC_RESULTS_20261012_R1.json). These are different packages and are not repeated bytes. Other saved public comparisons in the Oct 22 receipt do not establish a gain for either proposed endpoint.

recommendation.reason: The single replacement is the cheaper fixed endpoint and isolates the H390 S3 insertion under the TL3 scaffold; the two-seed replacement is a distinct follow-up testing S3/S4 contributions at a fixed total 0.34 coefficient. Neither has measured matched local quality or a supported public-score forecast. Root owns all package admission and upload decisions.
